title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Did you get a new car?
Nah, that’s my sisters. Had to leave mine Adrian to get looked at.
And what's going on with the job
Was literally just told i didn’t get it
Yeah, got called in after I finished working
Man, that is such a buzzkill
Yeah, I’m more stunned than anything right now
That pisses me off so much. You bust your ass more than any of those guys and then, this?
I know. I’m still in the same role and I’ll still keep doing a lot of in-game work, just don’t get to be full time.
Means I’ll be looking elsewhere for a full time gig.
